items.title: AgentBudget – Real-time dollar budgets for AI agents
items.raw_excerpt:
Hey HN, I built AgentBudget after an AI agent loop cost me $187 in 10 minutes — GPT-4o retrying a failed analysis over and over. Existing tools (LangSmith, Langfuse) track costs after execution but don't prevent overspend. AgentBudget is a Python SDK that gives each agent session a hard dollar budget with real-time enforcement. Integration is two lines: import agentbudget agentbudget.init("$5.00") It monkey-patches the OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs (same pattern as Sentry/Datadog), so existing code works without changes. When the budget is hit, it raises BudgetExhausted before the next API call goes out. How it works: - Two-phase enforcement: estimates cost pre-call (input tokens + average completion), reconciles post-call with actual usage. Worst-case overshoot is bounded to one call.
- Loop

Author: Wu You  Editor: Yu Kuai  
If evaluating the market acceptance of an AI hardware product by its crowdfunding amount, one million US dollars serves as a threshold. Surpassing this figure indicates that product-market fit is essentially viable, marking the birth of another hit product.  
The AI card phone MindOne, which garnered significant attention at CES 2026, was launched on Kickstarter in July last year. Priced starting at $299, it attracted support from 3,411 backers worldwide. Within 30 days of its release, it raised approximately $1.48 million. Supporters expressed interest in its convenience, AI features, and retro design.  
MindOne’s card-style design is compact and lightweight, with a thickness of 8.9mm and a weight of 136g, appealing to many users who pursue a minimalist lifestyle. Its 50-megapixel Sony main camera, along with a 180-degree reversible camera design, is also considered a highlight.  
In terms of AI functionality, it features dual-system switching between Android 15 and iKKO AI OS. Users can switch to AI OS focus mode with one click, enabling offline AI functions such as real-time translation, speech-to-text, and image analysis to enhance efficiency.  
Regarding expandability, the detachable keyboard case revives the "BlackBerry" era, receiving widespread acclaim from tech enthusiasts and retro aficionados.  
Just last week, iKKO completed its domestic debut at the INNO100 offline experience store in Shenzhen, accelerating its expansion into the Chinese market ahead of the Spring Festival.  
"Our primary targets are Europe, the United States, Japan, and Southeast Asia, with our user base covering white-collar professionals."

Con un precio inicial de 299 dólares, atrajo el apoyo de 3,411 patrocinadores globales. En 30 días, recaudó aproximadamente 1.48 millones de dólares. Los patrocinadores expresaron interés por su portabilidad, funciones de IA y diseño retro. El diseño de tarjeta de MindOne es compacto y ligero, con un grosor de 8 mm.

Author: Wu You  Editor: Yu Kuai  
Shortly after the 2023 Spring Festival holiday, employees of Teeni.AI received a company-wide notice from CEO Yuan Lin: "All business shifts to AI, focusing fully on youth-oriented intelligent agents." This decision stemmed from an intuition born of her dual identity—she is both a serial entrepreneur deeply involved in the children’s hardware sector and a mother of two children born in the 2010s.  

A decade ago, during her first venture, Yuan Lin’s product Pudding Doudou belonged to the AI 1.0 era. The team initially developed an OS system before targeting the children’s market, but the AI technology at the time "could only fool kids." The most popular feature was using the robot as a "messenger" to bridge communication between parents and children, which formed her initial understanding of children’s needs.  

Her second venture, Listening Bear, originally focused on English learning scenarios. It wasn’t until the explosion of GPT technology, watching her own children skillfully use AI to search for information and ask questions, that Yuan Lin suddenly realized: "This wave of opportunity cannot be missed." She immediately halted the original plans, led the training of a dedicated large model for youth, and launched an AI portable intelligent agent.  

Her experience of speaking with thousands of children each year helped her grasp the core of interacting with the post-2010 generation: "You have to squat down and speak their language; respect is more important than anything." She sharply pointed out a common industry flaw—many AI companion hardware rely on generic models with forced personas. In her view, AI should not play an omnipotent role but should serve as a "cognitive bridge," helping children connect the virtual and physical worlds.

Justo después de las vacaciones del Año Nuevo chino de 2023, los empleados de Teeni.AI recibieron una notificación de su CEO, Yuan Lin: "Todas las operaciones se orientarán hacia la IA, centrándonos al máximo en los agentes inteligentes para adolescentes." Detrás de esta decisión hay una intuición derivada de su doble identidad: es tanto una emprendedora en serie con profunda experiencia en el sector de hardware infantil como madre de dos hijos nacidos después de 2010. En su primer emprendimiento hace diez años, su producto Pudding Doudou aún estaba en la era de la IA 1.0. El equipo primero desarrolló un sistema operativo y luego se enfocó en el sector infantil, pero la tecnología de IA de entonces "solo podía engañar a los niños". La función más popular era hacer que el robot actuara como "mensajero".

items.title: “Car Wash” test with 53 models
items.raw_excerpt: "I Want to Wash My Car. The Car Wash Is 50 Meters Away. Should I Walk or Drive?" This question has been making the rounds as a simple AI logic test so I wanted to see how it holds up across a broad set of models. Ran 53 models (leading open-source, open-weight, proprietary) with no system prompt, forced choice between drive and walk, with a reasoning field. On a single run, only 11 out of 53 got it right (42 said walk). But a single run doesn't prove much, so I reran every model 10 times. Same prompt, no cache, clean slate. The results got worse. Of the 11 that passed the single run, only 5 could do it consistently. GPT-5 managed 7/10. GPT-5.1, GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, every Llama and Mistral model scored 0/10 across all 10 runs.
